status: design-only; no model training has been run

shared_protocol.class_imbalance: compute balanced class weights from train partition and reuse across candidates
shared_protocol.test_policy: Do not train, tune, threshold-select, or choose candidates with test results; evaluate once after model choice is frozen.

enhanced_candidates.name: EfficientNetV2B0_ECA
enhanced_candidates.change: one lightweight ECA channel-attention block before pooling

enhanced_candidates.name: EfficientNetV2B0_ECA_spatial

complexity_policy.extra_residual_or_depthwise_blocks: not added by default; consider only as isolated validation/latency ablations
complexity_policy.final_architecture: select using validation results and measured size/latency; no outcome assumed

subset_fallback.condition: only if full-data CPU training exceeds the agreed runtime budget
subset_fallback.proposal: after fixed split, cap training at 500 examples/class with seed 42; keep full validation/test and use the same selected rows for every model
